levels.surface: أبا بكر بن محمد بن عمرو بن حزم

notes: The appended remark «قال يزيد فحدثت هذا الحديث» is Yazid's own report to Abu Bakr that Abu Salama gave the same from Abu Hurayra: a variant, never a route. No previous report is supplied in the context, so «بهذا الإسناد» stays a back_reference. «مثله» is a wording remark.
